title.ja: 図1-1 銀から上がるのが嬉野流の出だし
title.en: Figure 1-1: Advancing the silver first is the opening of Ureshino style

explain.ja: テーマ図は、相手が角道を開けずにいきなり△4二銀としてきた局面です。この出だしを「嬉野流」といいます。狙いは角を引いて使っていくことです。級位者でも嬉野流を使う人は意外と多いので、しっかり対策しておきましょう。
explain.en: The theme diagram is the position where the opponent, without opening the bishop diagonal, plays △4二銀 right away. This start is called Ureshino-style. Its aim is to retreat the bishop and use it from behind. Quite a few kyu-level players use it, so prepare a solid answer.

section.ja: 嬉野流の出だし、振り飛車で対策していく
section.en: Ureshino school openings and how to counter them with Ranging Rook

title.ja: 図2-1 三間飛車に振る
title.en: Figure 2-1: Swing to Third File Rook

explain.ja: 嬉野流に対しては、三間飛車に振るのが無難な構えです。相手は図2-1から通常の対振り飛車の急戦に組み替えることもできますが、その場合も三間飛車で待機しているほうが指しやすいでしょう。急戦調の構えには四間飛車より三間飛車が向いています。
explain.en: Against Ureshino-style, swinging to Third File Rook is the safe setup. The opponent can switch from diagram 2-1 into a normal fast attack against Ranging Rook, but even then waiting with Third File Rook is more comfortable. Against an aggressive setup, Third File Rook suits better than Fourth File Rook.

section.ja: 急戦策には四間飛車より三間飛車!
section.en: Against fast attacks, Third File Rook is better than Fourth File Rook!

line.text: ▲6六歩、△5四歩、▲7八銀、△5三銀、▲7七角、△8四歩、▲6七銀、△8五歩、▲7八飛

title.ja: 図2-2 美濃囲いを急ぐ

explain.ja: こちらはまず美濃囲いを目指しながら、相手の仕掛けを待ちます。相手は角を引いて攻撃態勢を整えました。この相手の陣形は鳥刺しと呼ばれ、通常の居飛車の出だしからこの形に合流することもあります。
explain.en: We first aim for a Mino castle while waiting for the opponent to attack. The opponent retreats the bishop and prepares the attack. This formation is called Torisashi (Bird-Catching), and it can also be reached from a normal Static Rook opening.

section.ja: 相手は鳥刺しの陣形に
section.en: The opponent adopts the Torizashi formation

line.text: △3一角、▲4八玉、△4二玉、▲3八玉、△3二玉、▲2八玉、△7四歩、▲3八銀

title.ja: 図2-3 五筋の歩を突いておこう
title.en: Figure 2-3: Push the 5th-file pawn in advance

explain.ja: 図2-2では、相手はいつでも△7五歩から仕掛けられる状態です。仕掛けられる前に▲5六歩と突いておきます。これは将来、▲6八角から▲4六角と進めて飛車のコビンを狙う順を見ているためです。
explain.en: In diagram 2-2 the opponent can start an attack with △7五歩 at any time. Before that, play ▲5六歩. This looks ahead to the plan of ▲6八角 followed by ▲4六角, targeting the rook's kobin (the square diagonally in front of the rook).

title.ja: 図3-1 歩を取らずに角を引く
title.en: Figure 3-1: Retreat the bishop without capturing the pawn

explain.ja: 相手は△7五歩と仕掛けてきました。ここでは▲同歩と取らず、▲6八角と引くのが振り飛車らしい指し方です。ここから▲4六角を狙っていきます。▲5九角と引く手も有力です。
explain.en: The opponent attacks with △7五歩. Rather than capturing with ▲同歩, retreating the bishop with ▲6八角 is the Ranging Rook way. From there Black aims for ▲4六角. Retreating with ▲5九角 is also a strong option.

section.en: Retreat the bishop and use it

title.en: Figure 3-2: The opponent attacked the 7th file

explain.ja: まず、相手がすぐ△7六歩と歩を取り込んできた場合を見ます。相手はさらに△7二飛として7筋を狙ってきますが、ここで角を活用する手があります。
explain.en: First, consider the case where the opponent immediately captures with △7六歩. The opponent then plays △7二飛 to target the 7th file, but here Black has a move that puts the bishop to work.

section.ja: すぐ7筋の歩を取り込んできた場合
section.en: If the opponent immediately captures the 7th-file pawn

explain.ja: ▲4六角として斜めのラインから攻めます。相手は銀を下手に動かすと▲9一角成で香車を取られる形になりました。こちらは次に▲6五歩と銀を狙う手があり、振り飛車が指しやすい展開です。
explain.en: Black attacks along the diagonal with ▲4六角. If the opponent moves the silver carelessly, Black captures the lance with ▲9一角成. Black also has ▲6五歩 next to go after the silver, so the Ranging Rook side is comfortable.

section.ja: すぐ7筋の歩を取り込んできた場合
section.en: If the opponent immediately captures the 7th-file pawn

title.ja: 図4-1 鳥刺し＋棒銀の形
title.en: Figure 4-1: Torizashi plus Climbing Silver formation

explain.ja: 今度は、相手がもう一枚の銀も攻めに加えてきました。棒銀と斜め棒銀を合わせたような陣形で、セオリーではありませんが、級位者ではよく見る形なので紹介します。相手の攻め駒が多いので、うまく受け流してさばきを狙いましょう。
explain.en: This time the opponent adds the other silver to the attack. The formation is like Rushing Silver combined with a diagonal Rushing Silver. It is not theoretically sound, but it is common among kyu-level players, so it is shown here. Since the opponent has many attacking pieces, deflect the attack well and aim to free your pieces.

section.ja: 相手は棒銀の応援を送る
section.en: The opponent sends reinforcements for Climbing Silver

line.text: △6二銀、▲5八金左、△7三銀上、▲1六歩、△8四銀

title.ja: 図4-2 やはり▲4六角で振り飛車よし
title.en: Figure 4-2: ▲4六角 is good for Ranging Rook after all

explain.ja: 図4-1からも、やはり▲4六角を狙っていきます。図4-2では、美濃囲いにしっかり組んでいる先手に対して後手の陣形は薄く、先手が指しやすい局面です。
explain.en: From diagram 4-1 as well, Black aims for ▲4六角. In diagram 4-2, Black has a firm Mino castle while White's formation is thin, so Black is more comfortable.
